It was a special and open way to connect with amazing free people in an atmosphere of non-judgement when you
give away love and care without any agenda just for the sake of making people around you happier.
The best was riding bike through the playa and singing on the sunrise. I wasn't so close with myself for a while. I
forgot who I am, where I came from and started feeling myself deeper and better. I named it `freedom from
myself'.
Human Initiation show. Look like a religious ceremony. Was very special, moving and ... even political. Very few
people got in and everyone who was there is an incredible talented human. People were dancing in the middle of
fire, flying under the sky of pyramid, some Native American leaders were speaking about our relationships with
nature and plants. I felt it in every cell of my body. Unexplainable. Attached is a video of it.
Super sincere and sometimes beautiful art— all over. People who wrote poetry there made me cry.
I've got a better sense what kind of people are lighting up and lifting up others and learned how they think and
behave.
Finally — a super nice romantic story — deep, honest and sincere, really enjoyed every moment of it.
It was good to be my crazy self and to know no one is judging for that.
000
